comment: PEOPLE MAINNET allocation. Same 1B PPL supply and buckets as testnet (website/src/lib/tokenomics.ts). Fields marked owner_placeholder / placeholder must be replaced with real, independently held keys before the genesis ceremony; apply-emission-genesis.py and validate-emission-genesis.py refuse a mainnet genesis while any remain. Only public keys and addresses belong here, never private keys or mnemonics.

community.label: Community & rewards
community.note: 350M PPL, continuous vesting over 6 years from genesis. Funds the Million Founders program (incl. Genesis Quest up to 25M, decided 2026-11-01) and community rewards. BLOCKER: on testnet this address has no signer and no code path, so vested PPL can never move. Mainnet needs a spend path before genesis (recommended: peoplefees streams the vested amount into the x/distribution community pool each block, spent by governance proposals; alternative: the treasury multisig). Owner decides.

validators.label: Validators & staking pool
validators.note: Validator reward pool (200M PPL). M11-2 (owner-approved): each year's 60M/50M/50M/40M PPL tranche is laid out as ~365 daily PeriodicVestingAccount periods, not one yearly cliff; every block, StreamValidatorPool (chain/overrides/evmd/peoplefees) drains whatever the SDK's native vesting lock has already unlocked and pays it to whichever validators signed the previous block, in addition to the 30% live fee share.

team.label: Team & founders
team.note: A11: 0% at genesis, 6-month cliff, then 18 months linear. Owner supplies the team-controller address (a key or multisig held by the team, not on any server) before the ceremony.

treasury.label: Ecosystem treasury (DAO)
treasury.note: A11: 0% at genesis, 6-month cliff, then 18 months linear, on the mainnet 2-of-3 treasury multisig below.

sale.label: Community sale
sale.note: Mainnet: spendable on the 2-of-3 treasury multisig from genesis, so the multisig can fund PplSaleDistributor (PR #88) in tranches after it is deployed on 97400. On testnet this was the keyless people_sale module account, which nothing can spend.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.note: Same 2-of-3 mainnet treasury multisig, spendable from genesis (one PPL/pUSDC pool on PEOPLE at sale graduation, user decision 2026-11-01).

treasury_multisig.note: MAINNET 2-of-3 (owner, co-founder, owner's cold key). Must NOT reuse the testnet signer keys. Proposed: the three owners of the Base sale Safe (their eth_secp256k1 public keys, recoverable from any Base transaction they signed). The address goes into peoplefees.MainnetTreasuryMultisigAddress too; validate-emission-genesis.py cross-checks both.

mainnet_prep.note: Validators run on separate servers and sign their own gentx (scripts/mainnet/). Keys use the file keyring, never test. validator_reserve_appl is each genesis validator operator's liquid balance (carved out of community); validator_self_delegation_appl is the gentx bond.

distribution.comment: Must stay 0 while Model A is enforced in peoplefees (25% community). Non-zero community_tax would re-split any fee-collector dust and double-count the community share.

fee_sink_modules.comment: Fees go straight to treasury_multisig.address (peoplefees, mainnet multisig selected by chain-id). Module names kept only for the testnet upgrade sweep.

genesis_extra_accounts.comment: Mainnet: no faucet, no deployer, no test accounts.
